subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'has.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given phrase, we are talking about** 'medical science' **in Present Tense which is a singular subject.
 
• Therefore, we need **'has'** and the options **'had' and 'have' **are ruled out.
 
• **‘Has been’** suggests an action that started in the past, but continues in the present.
 
 
• **Example**:* A bird **has been** following me all day long.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'has.'
 
• The correct phrase: *......... **practises transplant surgery and **has** rid whole countries of such killing.........*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• When we are talking about the past: for any subject (I, You, He, She,It, We, They) we use **‘had been‘.**
 
• “Had been,”, suggests an action that both began and ended in the past.
 
 
• **Example**: *I had been reading articles on English language for three hours.​*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__***

 
• दिए गए वाक्यांश में, हम वर्तमान काल में 'medical science' के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं जो एक singular subject है।
 
• इसलिए, हमें 'has' की आवश्यकता है और विकल्प'had' and 'have' से इंकार किया जाता है।
 
• ‘Has been’ एक ऐसी क्रिया का सुझाव देता है जो अतीत में शुरू हुई थी, लेकिन वर्तमान में जारी है।
 
 
• Example:* A bird has been following me all day long.*
